metas.name: "Zigzag"
metas.note:
On the P24 between Oskemen and Semey, as well as in both cities, you can spot this “zigzag” shaped smudge on the left side of the car.

NOTE: The smudge is highlighted in the image, and will not appear pink on street view.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: 3 Dots (1)
metas.note: This combination of 3 dots; 2 of which are close together near the back of the roof, and a third one above to the left, can be found in the coverage north of Zhezqazghan, but not in the city itself.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: 3 Dots (2)
metas.note: Around Kyzylorda, there is another combination of 3 dots; one on the bottom right, and 2 dots side by side, closer to the middle.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: A1 Highway
metas.note:
The section of the A1 going from Astana to Shchuchinsk is a 6-lane divided highway. The landscape around is generally quite green, with trees and grassy plains or hills.

Driving direction: Both ways
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: A17 Highway
metas.note:
The A17 going to Ulytau Region can be recognised by the bad pavement quality, where the edges of the road are almost crumbling away, along with the single white middle road line, which can be dashed or solid. The landscape itself is a grassy steppe, with some fall coloured trees occasionally lining the roads.

West of Atasu, the sun is distinctly low on the horizon.

NOTE: A small section east of Atasu has pristine new pavement, which has a slight red tint to it.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: A26 Highway
metas.note:
The A26 goes from Kandyagash to the intersection of M32/E38.

It has very bad road quality throughout, ranging from poor grainy pavement, to completely unpaved. Apart from the northernmost section, the weather is either cloudy or overcast.

The landscape consists mostly of flat, semi-arid grassy plains.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: A3/P130 Highway
metas.note:
The roads from Kyzylagash to Druzhba feature a unique hilly landscape, which looks hazy and dead. On most sections, you will see small mountains either south or east of the road.

Driving direction: East from Kyzylagash.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Akmola Pole Paint
metas.note: Akmola region has a very thin layer of red, then white, and a thin layer of black on the bottom.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Aktobe Bus
metas.note: Aktobe uses orange and black buses.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Aktobe Street Sign
metas.note: Aktobe has compact signs where half of the space is taken by the QR code.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Almaty Bus
metas.note: Almaty uses fully green buses, with white patterns and the city name on the sides. Taraz can use similar buses, but they will have “Taraz” written on the sides instead.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Altyn Emel National Park
metas.note: The Altyn Emel National Park is a barren grassland with snowy mountains in all directions. Some parts are very snowy. And in the eastern section, there is a small curvy mountain pass.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Astana Bus
metas.note: Astana commonly uses these white, black, and green electric buses.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Astana Street Sign
metas.note: Astana consistently uses this fairly generic design.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Atyrau Bus Stop
metas.note: Atyrau has a modern design, with white and lime/neon green walls. The bus stop name is prominently written on top.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Atyrau Pole Paint
metas.note:
Atyrau Region uses blue, white, and black paint.

This pole paint can only be found in the cities of Inderbor, Dossor and Atyrau. (All in Atyrau region)
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Atyrau Traffic Light Post
metas.note:
A couple of times you will see this Traffic Light Posts. These Posts are exclusive to the city of Atyrau.

NOTE: This meta works only 99% of cases.
metas.footer: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ps7q9sqbnFcEi6y2KM0zZ7KtUNKjMh3M7o_-exFAw3M/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.aphu0k29nmb5 (User: BnDGz)

metas.name: Baltic Pine Forests
metas.note:
Coverage in dense baltic pine forests can be found north of Shchuchinsk, which is north of Astana.

NOTE: Baltic pines can be found in other parts of the country.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Black and White Curbs
metas.note: The city of Kostanay has a lot of these Black and White curbs. In almost every location, you will see these curbs.
metas.footer: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ps7q9sqbnFcEi6y2KM0zZ7KtUNKjMh3M7o_-exFAw3M/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.aphu0k29nmb5 (User: BnDGz)

metas.name: Blue Roof
metas.note:
In the city of Aktobe there are a lot of houses with blue roofs.

NOTE: Please don't use this meta if you see only one blue roof. Almost every other city in Kazakhstan has also houses with blue roofs.
metas.footer: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ps7q9sqbnFcEi6y2KM0zZ7KtUNKjMh3M7o_-exFAw3M/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.gwr7qtdfbb4s (User: BnDGz)

metas.name: Coating of Dirt
metas.note: Between Kokshetau and Atbasar, the car has a thin coating of dirt and dust, which is most visible near the back of the roof.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Desert Landscape
metas.note: Sandy and shrubby desert-like landscapes are common in southwestern Kazakhstan.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Dirty Car
metas.note:
In the highlighted coverage east of Almaty, the back of the roof is very dirty.

NOTE: Similar dirty cars can be found in some nearby cities.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: E38 Highway
metas.note:
The divided section of the E38 goes southeast to northwest from Shymkent to Kyzylorda. The road is made of asphalt, and it has all white road lines. The landscape varies quite a lot; in the south, it is very green and in the north, it gets dry, sandy, and shrubby.

Driving direction: Both ways
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Ekibastuz Pole Paint
metas.note: Ekibastuz has a thin layer of blue, and white
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Faint Dot
metas.note:
South of Beyneu, there is a faint dot on the middle-right of the roof.

NOTE: This dot along with other smudges can be found in some nearby cities.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Green Plains
metas.note: Vast grassy green plains are found in northwestern Kazakhstan. They are especially common in Akmola and Kostanay regions.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Hazy Forest Fire Coverage
metas.note: Parts of Oskemen have hazy forest fire coverage.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Hilly + Dry
metas.note: The landscape in southern Kazakhstan near Uzbekistan is hilly and quite dry and shrubby, with a lot of orange looking grass. The landscape consists of dry but grassy rolling hills or dead flat agricultural land near Zhetisay.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Hilly + Forested
metas.note: The East Kazakhstan Region is hilly and forested. It was covered in october, so you will see fall colours on the vegetation. The town of Ridder itself is flat, but surrounded by hazy mountains.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Karaganda Bus
metas.note: Karaganda uses turquoise buses, just like their bus stops.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Karaganda Bus Stop
metas.note: Karaganda uses old looking turquoise bus stops, which have a curved roof.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Kentau Pole Paint
metas.note: Kentau poles have thin layers of blue, yellow, and red, then blue and black below them.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Kokshetau Pole Paint
metas.note: Kokshetau uses a few designs, but they all have light blue on the bottom, and sometimes, a thin strip, or two, of yellow on top.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Kostanay Bus Stop
metas.note: Kostanay uses simple brown bus stops, that have a blue and yellow crest on one of the glass panes.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Kostanay Pole Paint
metas.note: Kostanay uses a thin layer of turqoise, and yellow.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Kulsary Lamp
metas.note: Lamps in Kulsary have a sizable blue photocell on the top.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Kyrgyz KM Marker
metas.note: These red and white KM markers that look like Kyrgyz ones, are only found near Zhetisay.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Kyzylorda Lamp Post Paint
metas.note: Kyzylorda lamp posts are white, and have turquoise on the bottom.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Kyzylorda Pole Paint
metas.note: Kyzylorda poles have a thin layer of yellow and red, then white.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Line of Dirt
metas.note: East of Aktobe, there is a vertical line of dirt on the right side of the roof.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Lush Birch Forest
metas.note:
These lush birch forests next to green fields are common in northern Kazakhstan.

NOTE: This landscape often appears very similar to that found in and around Omsk Oblast in Russia.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: M36 Highway (1)
metas.note:
Between Karaganda and Astana, the M36 is now a divided highway, with yellow outer lines. The landscape consists of a grassy, sometimes hilly, steppe with an occasional row of trees along the road. Note that the general southeast to northwest road angle is important.

Driving direction: Both ways
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: M36 Highway (2)
metas.note:
The section of the M36 going from Karaganda to Almaty can often be recognised by the road being under construction, with a second lane being built. Yellow lines are common. As for the landscape, it’s a wintery dry steppe, which looks noticeably orange-brown.

Driving direction: South from Karaganda.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: May Coverage
metas.note: The only May coverage in Kazakhstan is found in the Almaty exclave of Alataou, which is east of Almaty proper. All of the coverage is sunny and the mountains are visible to the south.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: P4/A17 Highway
metas.note:
The P4/A17 from Astana to Pavlodar is a divided road, generally going east to west, through a hilly steppe landscape similar to the M36, but is generally less vegetated. Most of the road has outer yellow lines.

Driving direction: Both ways
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Pavlodar Pole Marking
metas.note: This exclusive pole marking can only be found in Pavlodar.
metas.footer: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ps7q9sqbnFcEi6y2KM0zZ7KtUNKjMh3M7o_-exFAw3M/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.gwr7qtdfbb4s (User: BnDGz)

metas.name: Petropavl Bus Stop
metas.note: Petropavl also has brown bus stops, with glass panes on all 3 sides not facing the road. The roof is angled slightly upwards.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Petropavl Pole Paint
metas.note: Petropavl has a thin layer of white, and light grey.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Petropavl Street Sign
metas.note: Petropavl uses white signs, with a blue semicircle below the street names.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Pine Trees
metas.note: Around Semey, you can find small clusters or entire forests consisting mostly of pine trees and some deciduous trees, which will have fall colours.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: R260 road
metas.note:
The R260 road is mostly paved, but not in the best condition; many cracks can be seen, and it mostly lacks road lines. The weather is overcast and the landscape is a slightly hilly steppe, consisting of somewhat yellow grass and reddish soil, which is very evident when the road is unpaved.

The R217 is very similar, but the road is in better condition and mostly has very faded dashed white middle road lines, which are often quite difficult to see. The further east you go, the more sparse the cloud cover gets.

Driving directions: South from Atbasar
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Road of Zhezgazghan
metas.note:
The road north of Zhezqazghan has no road lines. The landscape is very dry, desolate, with very limited vegetation and slightly hilly. The soil can look very red or orange at times.

The weather is sunny, with a lot of cumulus clouds.

Driving directions: North from Nikolskiy
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Rolling grassy hills
metas.note: Grassy green rolling hills can be found in southern Kazakhstan. They are especially common just north of Bishkek
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Rudny Pole Paint
metas.note: Rudny has red, yellow, red on the top, with white below it.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Semey Bus
metas.note: Semey has these light green and white buses.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Shchuchinsk Pole Paint
metas.note: Shchuchinsk has a thin layer of red, and yellow.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Shymkent Pole Paint
metas.note: Shymkent poles have a thin layer of yellow and red, then green.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Small Ridge of Hills
metas.note: A small ridge of hills is visible to the north in a lot of Taldykorgan coverage.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Small Smudge
metas.note: Between Petropavl and Kokshetau, there is a small smudge slightly to the left on the bottom of the roof.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Snow Coverage
metas.note: Snow coverage can be found in southeastern Kazakhstan, especially east of Almaty.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Snow Coverage in Mountains
metas.note: In southern Almaty City, there is snow coverage in the mountains.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Speckled Roof
metas.note: On the borderroad from Kazakhstan to Uzbekistan, the google truck has a distinct speckled roof.
metas.footer: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ps7q9sqbnFcEi6y2KM0zZ7KtUNKjMh3M7o_-exFAw3M/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.gwr7qtdfbb4s (User: BnDGz)

metas.name: Tall Mountains
metas.note: Tall mountains, which are often snow-capped, can be seen in southeastern Kazakhstan.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Taraz Pole Paint
metas.note: Taraz has red, yellow, and black.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Turkistan Lamp
metas.note: Turkistan consistently uses these thin grey lamps with two small light sources near the end.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Unpaved Sandy Desert Road
metas.note: Near the Turkmenistan border in southwest Kazakhstan, you will find this unpaved sandy desert road. The landscape is almost blindingly bright from the sand.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Uralsk Lamp
metas.note: Some lamps in Uralsk have this very unique design, with 3 separate lamps in an ascending pattern.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Visible Wire
metas.note: A visible wire in the back of the Street View car can be found in all of western Kazakhstan.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: West Kazakhstan Pole Paint
metas.note: West Kazakhstan Region uses red, white, and black paint.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Yellow Boxes
metas.note:
Yellow boxes connected to the gas pipes are common outside houses in Shymkent, Turkistan, and Taldykorgan.

NOTE: In Shymkent the boxes are almost completely silver. In Turkistan, the boxes have a faded yellow color. And in Taldykorgan, the boxes are completely yellow (They look very new).
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Zhetisay Street Sign
metas.note: Zhetisay also uses a fairly generic design, but it is not found in Turkistan or Shymkent.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.

metas.name: Zhezqazghan Bus
metas.note: Zhezqazghan has orange and white buses, with “Men ♥ Jezz/Zhez” written on the sides.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/kazakhstan.
